highlights.title: Photos, camera and files from +
highlights.line: Tap + and pick a screenshot, take a photo or choose a file: it goes with your message.

highlights.title: Copy a whole message
highlights.line: Hold any message's text, then Copy message: all of it, as plain text.

highlights.title: Reports open as pages
highlights.line: Tap an HTML report in Chat: it opens as a page, charts and all.

fixes: Closing a sheet no longer leaves the app blank.
A finished Session's chat, and the files it named, still open.
